notes: New in Claude Code v2.1.251. Exit code 2 or a top-level decision: 'block' cancels the switch. permissionDecision accepts allow/deny/ask only -- 'defer' is not accepted, and updatedInput/additionalContext are not accepted. Precedence across hooks: deny > ask > allow. Only /model in an interactive session can show the 'ask' prompt; every other surface treats 'ask' as a refusal. A hook that doesn't respond before its timeout BLOCKS the switch (opposite of PreToolUse); default timeout 30 seconds. Runs command, http and mcp_tool hooks only. Matcher compares against the canonical name of the target model, ignoring any [1m] suffix; when no canonical name can be determined, every PreModelSwitch hook runs regardless of matcher. Not run for switches Claude Code makes on its own (automatic fallback, session-resume restore) -- those reach PostModelSwitch only.
